<h1>bootstrict</h1>

[`{bootstrict}` provides strict, faithful Bootstrap 5 widgets for `{shiny}`.]{.gv-pkg-tagline}

The goal of `{bootstrict}` is to provide strict, faithful Bootstrap 5.2 widgets for `{shiny}` — with minimum deviation from `{shiny}` itself.
